about: Where each FSR channel and each NTC temperature site sits on the insole (DATA-CONTRACT v1.6 section 3.1, user decision 2026-10-29). Index = FSR channel index on the wire = temperature site index in the v1.6 temperature packet: NTC i sits next to FSR i, so one list serves both. The Flutter app mirrors this file in mobile/lib/config/foot_layout.dart (a Dart test keeps them identical); tools/capture/load_capture.py reads the ids. Ids 0-5 are the ids stored alerts and capture files already use, kept even where the name changed.
frame: Left foot seen from above. x is measured from the insole's lateral edge toward the medial side, y from the back edge of the heel toward the toes. The right foot is the mirror image: the same index has the same x and y measured from its own lateral edge and heel.

regions.about: Coarse parts of the foot used in plain-Thai sentences and by the rule-based gait classes (forefoot share = forefoot sites, heel share = heel sites; lateral and arch are in neither).

display.about: How the app places a site on its stylised foot map (DESIGN-SPEC section 5: a 120 x 268 view box per foot, left foot, toes at the top). view_x = x0 + scale * x_mm, view_y = y0 - scale * y_mm; the right foot uses viewBox width - view_x. One uniform scale, fitted to the old placeholder positions of sites 0-5; every site centre falls inside the outline.
